about: Shared boarddd/impedance field-solver cases (generated by make_cases.mjs; lengths in mm). See docs/impedance.md.

cohn.about: Cohn 1954/1955 exact conformal maps for zero-thickness strips (tier 1 at t = 0, checked against scipy.special.ellipk to 1e-13)

polar.about: Polar Instruments Si9000 (BEM field solver), published microstrip cases: IPC 1999 paper, https://www.polarinstruments.com/support/cits/IPC1999.pdf

hfss.about: Ansys HFSS, 1 GHz full-wave with loss, as published in Ttl/js_2d_fields tests/test_vs_ref.js (loss raises Z about 0.5-1 % over a quasi-static answer)

hj.about: Hammerstad-Jensen 1980 for t = 0 (Z of the air line within 0.01 %, εeff within 0.2 % by its authors), as scikit-rf computes it

warnings: Bottom Solder Mask: no thickness, using 0.01 mm
Bottom Solder Mask: no epsilon_r, using 3.3
